format.run: uv run ruff format --check src tests docs/examples

quirks: The repository only squash-merges with the pull request title as the commit message, and python-semantic-release reads that title on every push to main to cut a release and publish it to PyPI, so the title's type must follow the commit-type table.

The repository's own docs (CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/gh-workflow/SKILL.md, .github/CONTRIBUTING.md and the pull request template) still use `Closes #N`; agents reference issues with `Relates to #N` instead.

`make install` and `make all` run pre-commit, which needs git and fails in a worktree's container; the hooks (ruff, pyright, markdownlint, conventional-pre-commit) run on the host with `pre-commit run`.
In the container pyright downloads Node.js through nodeenv, which fails on a Node.js pre-release unless `PYRIGHT_PYTHON_NODE_VERSION=lts` is set.
Besides the required checks, main's ruleset blocks merging on CodeQL alerts of high severity or more, code quality warnings, unresolved review threads and a missing code owner approval.

stack.basis: Estimate: a single Python devcontainer, no services; a trial worktree stack peaked near 130 MiB during pyright and used about 0.8 GiB of disk (container layer and .venv) over the shared 2.5 GB base image.
